summary: Iteration 3 stabilization pass on Raha Supermarket admin-app (production Firebase, live data). VERIFIED all four main fixes from this iteration: (1) documentToOrder mapping — RH78387575 (Delivered) admin view shows collapsed strip 'Delivered by Pradeep' AND expanded card shows 'Delivered by Pradeep', 'Mobile: +91 7838616364', 'Vehicle: up32nb6543' (rendered as UP32NB6543-style lowercase in current UI), 'Assigned at' and 'Delivered at' timestamps, and neither 'Assign rider' nor 'Change delivery boy' button is present on the delivered order. (2) Auth-restore race — full browser reload on /admin/orders KEEPS user on /admin/orders and orders list re-populates with all 3 orders (no redirect to /admin/login). (3) expo-notifications web guard — NO `crypto.getRandomValues` errors, NO `getLastNotificationResponse is not available on web` errors observed on any admin screen this run; only a benign informational warning '[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web. Adding a listener will have no effect.' remains. (4) Delivery module — Pradeep login succeeds, dashboard shows 'Hi, Pradeep' with vehicle 'up32nb6543' and stats 0 Active · 1 Delivered · 1 Total; Active tab shows empty-state 'No active orders' correctly. Additionally found and FIXED a JSX bug on Admin Dashboard where `keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"` was placed AFTER the ScrollView's `>` closing bracket in /app/admin-app/app/admin/index.tsx (lines 146-150), rendering the literal string as a visible text node and producing 'Unexpected text node' console error. Customer regression sweep, coupon UI, notifications-broadcast screen, and admin reports screen were NOT re-tested this iteration (iteration_1 covered customer regression comprehensively); the assign→out-for-delivery→delivered lifecycle drive using a newly placed test order was NOT executed due to strict LIVE PRODUCTION DATA constraints (limited test order creation risk & token budget). Recommend main agent self-verify the assign→deliver flow using the existing 'Placed' order RH82099032 in-app if desired, or that this iteration's targeted fix-verifications are sufficient before Android release.

ui_bugs.issue: JSX syntax bug: `keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"` was placed on a line AFTER the ScrollView opening tag was already closed with `>`, so it rendered as a text node child of the ScrollView. Visible as raw text on admin dashboard and produced console error 'Unexpected text node: keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled". A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' FIXED by moving the prop inside the ScrollView tag before `>`.

rca_of_issue: Admin Dashboard visible text bug: In /app/admin-app/app/admin/index.tsx, the ScrollView opening tag was closed with `>` on line 149 after `showsVerticalScrollIndicator={true}>`, then `keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"` appeared on line 150 (no `<`), so JSX parsed it as a text child of ScrollView. React Native Web threw 'Unexpected text node: keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled". A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' Fix: moved the prop into the ScrollView opening tag before the `>` and re-formatted. Verified no additional occurrences via grep across the codebase.
